description: This file provides functions for media understanding tasks such as describing images, videos, and transcribing audio files. It interfaces with media runtime plugins, handles media file processing, and exports functions for external use.

methods.name: buildFileContext
methods.description: Constructs a media context object with file path and MIME type.

methods.name: runMediaUnderstandingFile
methods.description: Main function to process media files for various capabilities (image, video, audio) and return descriptive results.

methods.name: describeImageFile
methods.description: Convenience function to describe an image file.

methods.name: describeImageFileWithModel
methods.description: Describes an image file using a specified provider and model, with optional prompt and timeout.

methods.name: transcribeAudioFile
methods.description: Transcribes an audio file to text.
